title: Naruto (manga)
subtitle: Masashi Kishimoto
blurb: All 700 chapters across 72 volumes, in publication order — finished.
notes: Sections are the 72 collected tankōbon. Wikipedia's Naruto chapter lists enumerate volumes and nothing else — the arc names people use come from fan wikis — so the volume is the only boundary this list can take from a source rather than invent. Each volume's first chapter is stated by the table it comes from, and the generator checks the 72 volumes tile chapters 1–700 with no gap or overlap.

Part I runs to chapter 244 and closes volume 27; Part II picks up at 245 and runs to the end. The six chapters that finish volume 27 are a gaiden — set before the main story, numbered straight through with everything else, which is why the count never breaks.
Every row is the chapter's English title and nothing more. The source has a summary for each volume and this list deliberately does not carry it: of everything here, Naruto is the easiest to spoil.
Finished — September 1999 to November 2014, 700 chapters, no more coming. Nothing to rerun for.
